blocks.prompt: 13 A company starts with an initial inventory of 1,000 items. Each month, the company restocks 100 items and expects inventory costs to grow at 2% per month due to inflation. Use the binomial theorem to estimate the inventory cost after 6 months.
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein do cheezein badal rahi hain: items ki tadaad (har mahine +100) aur ek item ki qeemat (har mahine \(\times 1.02\)).
Sawal mein ek item ki qeemat nahi di gayi, is liye jawab aaj ki qeemat \(c\) (ek item) ke hisaab se denge.
Rule kaunsa? Growth factor \((1 + 0.02)^6\) ke liye binomial theorem.
Plan: 6 mahine baad items, phir qeemat ka growth factor, phir dono ka product.
Socho: ghar ka sauda har mahine thora mehnga hota hai aur saath saath ghar mein cheezein bhi barhti hain; kul kharcha dono wajah se barhta hai. Yahan bhi yehi baat hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: shuru mein 1000 items; har mahine +100 items; qeemat 2% = 0.02 mahana barhti hai; waqt 6 mahine.
Humein find karna hai: 6 mahine baad inventory ki andazan cost.
Tareeqa: Maan lein aaj ek item ki qeemat \(c\) hai. 6 mahine baad ek item \(c(1 + 0.02)^6\) ka hoga; \((1.02)^6\) ka andaza binomial theorem se lagayenge. Phir cost = (items ki tadaad) \(\times\) (ek item ki nayi qeemat).

6 mahine baad items
\[1000 + 6 \times 100 = 1600 \text{ items}\]
Kyun: Chhe mahine, har mahine 100 items jude, to 600 naye items. Is sawal mein koi item bikta nahi, sirf restock hota hai. Yeh hissa seedhi addition hai (har mahine barabar izafa), is mein binomial theorem ki zaroorat nahi; binomial sirf qeemat wale hisse mein aayega, jahan har mahine multiply hota hai.
Dhyan dein: Items ko bhi 1.02 se multiply kar dena ghalti hai; 2% ka izafa qeemat mein hai, items ki tadaad mein nahi.

Qeemat ka growth factor
\[(1 + 0.02)^6 = 1 + 6(0.02) + 15(0.02)^2\]
\[+ 20(0.02)^3 + \dots\]
Kyun: 2% mahana barhne ka matlab har mahine qeemat 1.02 guna. 6 mahine mein \((1.02)^6\). Coefficients Pascal's triangle ki row 6 se: 1, 6, 15, 20, 15, 6, 1.

Terms ki value
\[= 1 + 0.12 + 0.006 + 0.00016 + \dots\]
\[\approx 1.126\]
Kyun: \((0.02)^2 = 0.0004\) aur \((0.02)^3 = 0.000008\). Agla term \(15(0.02)^4 = 0.0000024\) itna chhota hai ke jawab par asar nahi daalta. Matlab 6 mahine mein qeemat taqreeban 12.6% barh jati hai.

Cost ka andaza
\[\text{Cost} \approx 1600 \times 1.126\,c\]
\[= 1801.6\,c\]
Kyun: 1600 items mein se har ek ab taqreeban \(1.126c\) ka hai. Sawal 6 mahine baad ki cost poochh raha hai, is liye poore stock ko 6th mahine ki qeemat par gina.
Dhyan dein: Items (1600) aur cost (rupees) do alag cheezein hain; jawab mein unit ka khayal rakhein.

Tasdeeq
\[(1.02)^6 = 1.126162\ldots\]
\[1600 \times 1.126162 = 1801.86\]
Kyun: Calculator se exact factor 1.126162 aata hai. Humare andaze 1.126 aur is mein sirf chauthe decimal ka farq hai, aur cost mein farq 1801.6 ke muqable 1801.86, yani nihayat mamooli. Is liye binomial andaza bilkul theek hai. Chhote rate (2%) par pehle chand terms hi kaafi hote hain, yehi is tareeqe ki khoobi hai.
blocks.final_answer: 6 mahine baad 1600 items honge aur cost aaj ki 1600 items ki cost ka taqreeban \(1.126\) guna hogi, yani \(\approx 1801.6\,c\) (\(c\) = aaj ek item ki qeemat). Misaal: agar aaj ek item Rs. 100 ka ho to cost taqreeban Rs. 180,160.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein "180,160 items" likha hai. 6 mahine baad stock 1600 items hai, 180,160 nahi. \(180{,}160 = 1600 \times 1.126 \times 100\) rupees mein cost hai, aur woh bhi sirf tab jab aaj ek item Rs. 100 ka ho, jo sawal mein diya hi nahi gaya.
